column1: # Original DICE Pin Pong, DIP 1 (1 coin / 2 credits, free ball enabled, 3 balls). One coin (500 ms)
# buys two games. Start (1500 ms) begins the first; the flippers rest and Start serves each lost ball
# until the game ends; Start then begins the second game on the remaining credit, played the same way;
# a third Start without a coin does not begin a game.
